description: Find Nationalrat roll calls with mode votes and businessId, sessionId, or both. Use mode members with voteId for one paged roll call, or personNumber without voteId for member history optionally filtered by businessId and sessionId. Use mode groups with voteId for complete decision counts by parliamentary group. Member roll calls start in the 2003 winter session and exclude Ständerat member votes; an empty result does not prove no vote occurred. Member counts cover only delivered rows; groups mode reads all published member rows before reporting totals. Verbatim decisionTexts accompany code buckets when published. Code meanings include 1 yes, 2 no, 3 abstention, 4 present, 5 did not participate, 6 excused under Art. 57 para. 4, 7 president does not vote, and 8 resigned. Unknown codes and missing decisions are retained. Follow nextOffset with the same mode and filters.

businessId.description: Votes or member history only: canonical eight-digit businessId from chparl_search_business, or a published short number such as 99.1234.

language.description: Metadata language: de (default), fr, or it; decision text remains as published.

limit.description: Paged modes only: votes default 10/max 50, members default 50/max 100; higher requests are clamped with notice.

mode.description: Workflow: votes (default), members, or complete groups.

offset.description: Paged modes only: starting row offset, default zero; continue using returned nextOffset.

personNumber.description: Members only: exact PersonNumber from chparl_search_members, distinct from Person.ID or current group affiliation.

sessionId.description: Votes or member history only: positive Int32 Session.ID from chparl_list_reference topic sessions; combine with businessId to narrow discovery.

voteId.description: Members or groups only: positive Int32 Vote.ID discovered through votes mode; omit for personNumber history. Cannot combine with businessId or sessionId.
